title: Custom Error Types
concept: Define custom error types as enums with descriptive variants — giving callers precise information about what went wrong.
why: Generic errors like 'something failed' are useless. Custom error types let callers handle specific failures differently and provide meaningful messages.
tips: Each error variant should carry enough data for the caller to understand AND recover
Use descriptive variant names — ConfigError::FileNotFound is self-documenting
Group related errors into one enum — don't create a separate type for each error
Add Display/Debug implementations to error types for easy logging
common_mistakes: Creating error variants with no contextual data — the caller can't debug or recover
Using String for error messages instead of structured data — hard to match programmatically
Making error types too granular — 50 error variants for one function is excessive
